periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, sloping downwards toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovaloid with an approximate 1.5:1 ratio of longitudinal to transverse axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Marked downward tapering with a significant vertical offset between the geometric centroid and the inferior terminus.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad U-shaped posterior curve across the visible flank and shoulder region.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Band thickness comprises roughly 45% of the visible torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Inter-pinna distance is approximately 1.5 times the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Continuous, smooth convex curvature at the ear apex.
